text: {"memo": "ADOBE (ADBE) delivered solid top‑line growth in FY2024, with revenue reaching $21.50\u202fbillion versus $19.41\u202fbillion in FY2023. This represents a notable year‑over‑year increase that underscores the company\u2019s ability to expand its cloud‑based offerings and creative software adoption. Net income rose modestly to $5.56\u202fbillion in FY2024 from $5.43\u202fbillion a year earlier, while operating income improved to $6.74\u202fbillion from $6.65\u202fbillion. Diluted EPS advanced to $12.36 per share in FY2024, up from $11.82 in FY2023. Operating cash flow strengthened to $8.06\u202fbillion, exceeding the $7.30\u202fbillion generated in FY2023. Margins show a slight compression: net income margin fell to roughly 26% in FY2024 from about 28% in FY2023, and operating margin declined to around 31% from 34% a year ago. Despite the margin pressure, Adobe maintained robust cash generation and earnings growth, reflecting a resilient business model. View: The stock remains attractively positioned on solid cash flow and earnings momentum, though investors should monitor margin trends as the company scales."}
